timeline_planner.channel_context: Spanish-language YouTube channel called 'La Botica Ancestral' about medicinal plants and ancestral remedies. Each video focuses on ONE specific plant — the narrator names it explicitly in the SRT. CRITICAL: every ia_prompt must reference the EXACT plant, ingredient, symptom or action being narrated in that moment. Never use vague descriptions like 'generic plant' or 'red beverage' — name Hibiscus sabdariffa, Jamaica flowers, dried red calyxes, clay pot with infusion, etc. The visual style is hand-drawn illustration like a vintage botanical comic book.
timeline_planner.trigger_types_description: PLANT: any herb, plant, leaf, root, flower mentioned by name. AILMENT: any health condition, pain, disease, symptom described. PREPARATION: tea, infusion, tincture, poultice, how to prepare or apply. SCIENCE: biological mechanism, active compound, study, research mentioned. HISTORY: historical use, ancient culture, traditional medicine, ethnobotany. LOCATION: geographic origin of plant (Andes, Amazon, Mediterranean, etc.). CONTRAINDICATION: warnings, interactions, who should not use it.
timeline_planner.image_style: Hand-drawn illustration, comic book ink outlines, sepia and night-blue tones, hatching shading, narrative scene with a person doing an action related to what is being narrated, vintage lantern or candlelight atmosphere, aged paper texture, no text, no watermarks, 16:9
timeline_planner.veo_prompt_note: VEO prompt describes camera movement only, max 15 words. Examples: 'Slow pan across illustrated scene, warm lantern light', 'Gentle zoom into character hands preparing remedy'.
